payload.content: A weighted base and upright roll post keep this 6.5-inch freestanding paper towel holder steady on the kitchen counter, so you can tear sheets without the stand sliding or tipping. {FINISH_SENTENCE} Made from solid brass, it brings the lasting strength and crisp detail designers look for in classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware—translated here into a countertop paper towel stand that saves space. A felt pad on the base helps prevent scratching on your countertop or table. No assembly required, and the set includes the paper towel holder. From Allied Brass with a Limited Lifetime Warranty—an easy, design-forward alternative to an under cabinet paper towel holder when you want portability and a clean, classic look.
